name: gemini-notebook-mcp
description: Manage notebooks and sources through the Gemini Notebook remote MCP.

interface.longDescription: List and create your Gemini Notebook notebooks, add links or Markdown, and check source processing. This independent integration uses Google OAuth and currently requires an eligible personal Google account.
defaultPrompt: List the notebooks I can access.
Show the sources and their status in my selected notebook.

positive.prompt: List my Gemini Notebook notebooks. If there are more results, tell me.
positive.expected_behavior: Report names returned for the signed-in user and indicate if another page exists.

positive.prompt: Create a notebook named Review Sandbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one notebook and report the actual title and returned resource name.

positive.prompt: Add https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs to Review Sandbox as Gemini API Docs.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the intended notebook, submit the specified URL once and report the returned source name and state if present.

positive.prompt: In Review Sandbox, add a Markdown source titled Workshop notes with content: # Workshop followed on a new line by Bring a notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit only the requested Markdown to the resolved notebook and report the returned source.

positive.prompt: In Review Sandbox, check the processing state of the source titled Gemini API Docs.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named source and report its actual processing state.

negative.prompt: Delete Review Sandbox and all its sources.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration has no delete tool. Make no changes.

negative.prompt: Add https://example.com to one of my two notebooks called Duplicate Review without asking me which one.
negative.expected_behavior: If two notebooks match, ask the user to select a specific notebook before any write.

negative.prompt: Upload the PDF attached to this message into Review Sandbox as a file.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that file upload is unavailable through this MCP and make no changes.

publication.release_notes: Initial preview connects to Gemini Notebook tools for managing notebooks and tracking source ingestion.
